notes.title: Petoons Party, available soon on PS4 and Steam!
notes.content:
We are really close to be available on PS4 and PC!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34882692/43b516abc804322244846cecf95b5a519cfd2b1a.jpg

We are bringing local multiplayer, four islands and rock-paper-scissors to PlayStation 4 and Steam, so join us and have fun with the Petoons.

Previously released and enjoied in PS4 Europe (more than 100.000 players), now we are going worldwide and for PC gamers too. The game will also be available on Xbox One and Nintendo Switch throughout the second half of 2019, completing our multi-platform launch in the most important markets of the industry.

Petoons Party is intuitive and easy to handle, a party game full of fun and mini-games to enjoy with family and friends. The control system is very user friendly and adapted for all ages, so you can play in a shared gaming experience up to 4 players.

Petoons Party contains:

 3 Game modes
 4 Boards
 4 Cups
 28 Mini-games
